findings.source_quote: “At the time, they were thankful that the chickens had left the day before and that no one was close by when the propane tank exploded.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “walimshukuru Mungu kwamba kuku walikuwa wameondoka siku iliyotangulia” with “walishukuru kwamba kuku walikuwa wameondoka siku iliyotangulia” to avoid adding an explicit recipient of their thanks.
findings.translation_quote: “Wakati huo, walimshukuru Mungu kwamba kuku walikuwa wameondoka siku iliyotangulia”

findings.source_quote: “the chicken house needs to be finished in six months!”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “banda la kuku linahitaji kukamilika baada ya miezi sita” with “banda la kuku linahitaji kukamilika ndani ya miezi sita” to convey the stated deadline.
findings.translation_quote: “banda la kuku linahitaji kukamilika baada ya miezi sita!”

findings.source_quote: “Then I was asked to fill the position of food committee for Mrs. ‘Going-to-Bulgaria.’”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “kuchukua nafasi ya mjumbe wa kamati ya chakula” with “kuchukua nafasi katika kamati ya chakula” to avoid specifying that she was asked to be a committee member when the source does not specify that role.
findings.translation_quote: “Kisha niliombwa kuchukua nafasi ya mjumbe wa kamati ya chakula kwa ajili ya Bi. ‘Anayekwenda Bulgaria.’”

findings.source_quote: “Traumatic events in our plain circles tend to receive prayer, finances, and weekly budget updates.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “jumuiya zetu za Waamishi wa kale” with “jumuiya zetu za Waamishi wanaofuata maisha ya kawaida na yasiyo na anasa” or another standard rendering of “plain circles”; “wa kale” incorrectly suggests they are from an earlier era.
findings.translation_quote: “Matukio yenye kuleta kiwewe katika jumuiya zetu za Waamishi wa kale hupata maombi, msaada wa kifedha na taarifa za bajeti za kila wiki.”
“Ikiwa um elemewa na hali za maisha”
